
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/docker-mo/p/22461549" title="发布于 2026-08-14 08:23">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础容器化部署 Prometheus+Grafana 监控（单节点离线生产版）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一文档概述">一、文档概述</h2>
<p>本文档为<strong>企业生产级单节点监控 Docker</strong> <strong>容器化****部署手册</strong>，摒弃传统二进制裸机部署方式，采用 Dockerfile 自定义构建纯净监控镜像，无第三方冗余依赖、适配私有化离线部署场景。</p>
<p>本次部署完全兼容 CentOS、Rocky Linux、RHEL 全系服务器，适配企业机房物理机、虚拟机、K8s 集群底层资源监控场景，是中小企业标准化、可复用、可迁移的容器化监控架构方案。</p>
<p>整体采用单节点架构：Prometheus、Alertmanager、Grafana、Node Exporter 四大核心组件以容器化方式部署，统一版本管控、统一容器生命周期管理，支持批量迁移、快速扩容、环境一致性复用，解决传统二进制部署环境杂乱、迁移繁琐、版本不统一的痛点。</p>
<h2 id="二本次部署固定生产稳定版本">二、本次部署固定生产稳定版本</h2>
<p>沿用官方无 Bug 生产稳定版，社区成熟、适配性强、线上零故障，所有组件版本与原生二进制生产版本对齐，保证监控逻辑、指标采集、告警规则完全兼容：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>prometheus-3.13.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz（监控核心+时序数据库）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz（服务器资源指标采集客户端）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>grafana-13.1.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz（运维可视化大屏）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>alertmanager-0.33.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz（企业级告警统一管理组件）</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三容器化监控架构说明">三、容器化监控架构说明</h2>
<h3 id="31-数据流转架构企业标准">3.1 数据流转架构（企业标准）</h3>
<p>业务服务器 Node Exporter 容器/进程 → Prometheus 容器（定时抓取指标、存储时序数据、规则校验）→ Alertmanager 容器（告警分组、降噪、抑制、分发）→ Grafana 容器（可视化展示、大屏渲染、数据报表）</p>
<h3 id="32-容器化架构核心优势对比二进制部署">3.2 容器化架构核心优势（对比二进制部署）</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>环境隔离</strong>：所有监控组件容器化运行，不污染宿主机环境，无端口、依赖冲突风险</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>版本统一</strong>：Dockerfile 固化组件版本，任意服务器构建部署环境完全一致</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>离线复用</strong>：构建完成可导出镜像，支持离线批量部署、灾备快速恢复</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>运维极简</strong>：统一 Docker 命令管理启停、重启、日志查看，无需复杂 systemd 配置</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>安全合规</strong>：容器内最小权限运行，贴合企业等保安全规范</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>可迁移性强</strong>：镜像可跨服务器、跨集群迁移，适配云服务器、物理机、容器集群</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="四部署环境前置准备">四、部署环境前置准备</h2>
<h3 id="41-基础环境要求">4.1 基础环境要求</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>操作系统：CentOS 7/8、Rocky Linux、RHEL 全系</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>运行环境：Docker 20.10+、Docker Compose（可选）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>部署架构：单节点容器化部署（所有监控中心组件部署于同一监控服务器）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>网络要求：服务器内网端口通畅，关闭防火墙/放行监控端口</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="42-环境初始化生产必备">4.2 环境初始化（生产必备）</h3>
<h4 id="421-关闭防火墙与selinux">4.2.1 关闭防火墙与SELinux</h4>
<p>监控服务多端口通信，关闭拦截策略，避免容器端口映射失败、指标采集超时、接口访问异常</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 关闭并禁用防火墙
systemctl stop firewalld &amp;&amp; systemctl disable firewalld
# 临时关闭SELinux
setenforce 0
# 永久关闭SELinux（重启生效）
sed -i 's/^SELINUX=enforcing/SELINUX=disabled/' /etc/selinux/config
</code></pre>
<h4 id="422-安装docker环境">4.2.2 安装Docker环境</h4>
<p>若无Docker环境，执行以下命令安装官方稳定版Docker</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 安装依赖
yum install -y yum-utils
# 配置Docker官方源
yum-config-manager --add-repo https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo
# 安装Docker核心组件
yum install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io
# 启动Docker并设置开机自启
systemctl start docker &amp;&amp; systemctl enable docker
# 验证Docker版本
docker --version
</code></pre>
<h4 id="423-创建统一部署目录">4.2.3 创建统一部署目录</h4>
<p>规范生产目录结构，统一存放Dockerfile、配置文件、离线安装包、容器数据挂载目录</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mkdir -p /opt/monitor/docker/{prometheus,alertmanager,grafana,node_exporter}
cd /opt/monitor/docker
</code></pre>
<h3 id="43-离线包准备公网离线通用">4.3 离线包准备（公网/离线通用）</h3>
<p>将所有组件官方稳定包下载至 /opt/monitor/docker 对应的目录，支持公网wget下载或网盘离线获取</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># Prometheus核心包
wget https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/releases/download/v3.13.2/prometheus-3.13.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
# Node Exporter采集包
wget https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v1.12.1/node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz
# Alertmanager告警包
wget https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/releases/download/v0.33.1/alertmanager-0.33.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz
# Grafana可视化包
wget https://dl.grafana.com/oss/release/grafana-13.1.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
</code></pre>
<p>离线备选网盘资源：我的百度网盘链接: <a href="https://pan.baidu.com/s/19h3Lx4fRbZX0mbdfdGuCqA?pwd=jup2" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://pan.baidu.com/s/19h3Lx4fRbZX0mbdfdGuCqA?pwd=jup2</a> 提取码: jup2</p>
<h2 id="五各组件-dockerfile-镜像构建企业生产级">五、各组件 Dockerfile 镜像构建（企业生产级）</h2>
<p>本次采用<strong>rockylinux:10.0基础镜像</strong>构建</p>
<h3 id="51-node-exporter-容器镜像构建">5.1 Node Exporter 容器镜像构建</h3>
<h4 id="511-编写dockerfile">5.1.1 编写Dockerfile</h4>
<p>全程用的 rockylinux:10.0 镜像， 请先 pull 到本地</p>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">cd /opt/monitor/docker/node_exporter
cat &gt; Dockerfile &lt;&lt; EOF
# 基础镜像
FROM rockylinux:10.0

# 维护者
LABEL maintainer="Prometheus Node Exporter"

# 工作目录
WORKDIR /opt

# 拷贝离线安装包
ADD node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz .

# 修改目录名称
RUN mv node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-amd64 node_exporter \
    &amp;&amp; useradd -M -s /sbin/nologin prometheus \
    &amp;&amp; chown -R prometheus:prometheus /opt/node_exporter/

# 暴露端口
EXPOSE 9100

# 切换用户
USER prometheus

# 容器启动
CMD ["/opt/node_exporter/node_exporter"]
EOF
</code></pre>
<h4 id="512-构建镜像">5.1.2 构建镜像</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 上传node_exporter离线包至当前目录后执行构建
docker build -t node-exporter:V1.12.1  .
# 验证镜像
docker images | grep node-exporter
</code></pre>
<h4 id="513运行镜像">5.1.3、运行镜像</h4>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">[root@prometheus node_exporter]# docker run -d --name node_exporter --restart always -p 9100:9100 node-exporter:V1.12.1 
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>浏览器访问</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260813171633924-1790006610.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h3 id="52-alertmanager-容器镜像构建">5.2 Alertmanager 容器镜像构建</h3>
<h4 id="521-编写配置文件">5.2.1 编写配置文件</h4>
<pre><code class="language-YAML">cd /opt/monitor/docker/alertmanager
cat &gt; alertmanager.yml &lt;&lt; EOF
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
  smtp_smarthost: 'smtp.163.com:465'
  smtp_from: '158*****624@163.com'
  smtp_auth_username: '158****24@163.com'
  smtp_auth_password: '自己的校验码'
  smtp_require_tls: true
  smtp_hello: '163.com'

route:
  group_by: ['alertname','instance','severity']
  group_wait: 10s
  group_interval: 10s
  repeat_interval: 30m
  receiver: 'email-receiver'

receivers:
- name: 'email-receiver'
  email_configs:
  - to: '158***5624@163.com'
    send_resolved: true

inhibit_rules:
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname','instance']
EOF
</code></pre>
<h4 id="522-编写dockerfile">5.2.2 编写Dockerfile</h4>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">cat &gt; Dockerfile &lt;&lt; EOF
FROM rockylinux:10.0
LABEL maintainer="Prometheus Alertmanager"

WORKDIR /opt

ADD alertmanager-0.33.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz .

RUN mv alertmanager-0.33.1.linux-amd64 alertmanager \
    &amp;&amp; useradd -M -s /sbin/nologin prometheus \
    &amp;&amp; chown -R prometheus:prometheus alertmanager \
    &amp;&amp; mkdir -p alertmanager/data

COPY alertmanager.yml /opt/alertmanager/

EXPOSE 9093 9094

USER prometheus

CMD ["/opt/alertmanager/alertmanager","--config.file=/opt/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml","--storage.path=/opt/alertmanager/data","--cluster.advertise-address=0.0.0.0:9094"]
EOF
</code></pre>
<h4 id="523-构建镜像">5.2.3 构建镜像</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker build -t alertmanager:v0.33.1 .
docker images | grep alertmanager
</code></pre>
<h4 id="524-启动容器">5.2.4、 启动容器</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p>创建持久化目录</p>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">mkdir -p  /opt/monitor/docker/alertmanager/data
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>跑容器</p>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">docker run -d \
--name alertmanager \
--restart always \
-p 9093:9093 \
alertmanager:v0.33.1 
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>查看端口</p>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">[root@prometheus alertmanager]# netstat -ntulp | grep 9093
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>浏览器访问</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260813171708810-2147170297.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="53-prometheus-容器镜像构建">5.3 Prometheus 容器镜像构建</h3>
<h4 id="531-编写核心配置文件">5.3.1 编写核心配置文件</h4>
<pre><code class="language-YAML">cd /opt/monitor/docker/prometheus
cat &gt; prometheus.yml &lt;&lt; EOF
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - 127.0.0.1:9093

rule_files:
  - "rules/node-rule.yml"

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: "prometheus"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["127.0.0.1:9091"]

  - job_name: "node-exporters"
    static_configs:
      - targets: [ "192.48.75.190:9100" ]
EOF
</code></pre>
<h4 id="532编写-prometheus-告警规则文件">5.3.2、编写 Prometheus 告警规则文件</h4>
<p>新建主机监控告警规则文件：/opt/monitor/prometheus/rules/node-rule.yml</p>
<pre><code class="language-Shell"># 创建目录
[root@prometheus prometheus]# mkdir -p /opt/monitor/docker/prometheus/rules/
[root@prometheus prometheus]# vim mkdir -p /opt/monitor/docker/prometheus/rules/node-rule.yml
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-YAML">groups:
- name: node-cpu-alert-rule
  rules:
  # 服务器CPU使用率超载告警（企业通用阈值）
  - alert: ServerHighCpuUsage
    # PromQL语句：统计1分钟平均CPU使用率，空闲CPU低于30%即使用率超70%，触发告警
    expr: 100 - (avg by (instance) (irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[1m])) * 100) &gt; 70
    # 持续20秒超载才触发告警，过滤瞬时CPU波动，降低误告警率
    for: 20s
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: "主机 {{ $labels.instance }} CPU使用率超载"
      description: "主机当前CPU使用率为 {{ $value }}%，持续高于70%阈值，存在业务卡顿、性能过载风险！"
</code></pre>
<h4 id="533-编写dockerfile">5.3.3 编写Dockerfile</h4>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">cat &gt; Dockerfile &lt;&lt; EOF
FROM rockylinux:10.0
LABEL maintainer="prometheus"

WORKDIR /opt

ADD prometheus-3.13.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz .

RUN mv prometheus-3.13.2.linux-amd64 prometheus \
    &amp;&amp; useradd -M -s /sbin/nologin prometheus \
    &amp;&amp; chown prometheus:prometheus -R prometheus \
    &amp;&amp; mkdir -p prometheus/rules \
    &amp;&amp; chown prometheus:prometheus -R prometheus/rules \
    &amp;&amp;  mkdir -p prometheus/data \
    &amp;&amp; chown prometheus:prometheus -R prometheus/data

COPY prometheus.yml /opt/prometheus/
COPY rules/node-rule.yml  /opt/prometheus/rules/

EXPOSE 9090
USER prometheus

CMD ["/opt/prometheus/prometheus","--config.file=/opt/prometheus/prometheus.yml","--storage.tsdb.path=/opt/prometheus/data","--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d","--web.enable-lifecycle","--web.listen-address=0.0.0.0:9091"]
EOF
</code></pre>
<h4 id="534-构建镜像">5.3.4 构建镜像</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker build -t prometheus:v3.13.2 .
docker images | grep prometheus
</code></pre>
<h4 id="535启动容器">5.3.5、启动容器</h4>
<ul>
<li>跑容器</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">docker run -d \
--name prometheus \
--restart always \
-p 9091:9091 \
prometheus:v3.13.2
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>检查容器</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">[root@prometheus prometheus]# netstat -ntulp | grep 9091
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>浏览器访问</li>
</ul>

<hr>
<h3 id="54-grafana-容器镜像构建">5.4 Grafana 容器镜像构建</h3>
<h4 id="541-编写配置文件">5.4.1 编写配置文件</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd /opt/monitor/docker/grafana
cat &gt; grafana.ini &lt;&lt; EOF
[server]
http_addr = 0.0.0.0
http_port = 3000
[paths]
data = /opt/grafana/data
logs = /opt/grafana/logs
plugins = /opt/grafana/plugins
EOF
</code></pre>
<h4 id="542-编写dockerfile">5.4.2 编写Dockerfile</h4>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">cat &gt; Dockerfile &lt;&lt; EOF
FROM rockylinux:10.0

LABEL maintainer="Prometheus Dockerfile"

WORKDIR /opt/grafana

ADD grafana-13.1.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz .

RUN mv grafana-13.1.2/* . \
    &amp;&amp; rmdir grafana-13.1.2 \
    &amp;&amp; useradd -M -s /sbin/nologin grafana \
    &amp;&amp; mkdir -p /opt/grafana/{data,logs,plugins,config} \
    &amp;&amp; chown grafana:grafana -R /opt/grafana

COPY grafana.ini /opt/grafana/config/

EXPOSE 3000

USER grafana

# 直接启动，不需要GF_PATHS_HOME、不需要--homepath
CMD ["/opt/grafana/bin/grafana","server","--config=/opt/grafana/config/grafana.ini"]
EOF
</code></pre>
<h4 id="543-构建镜像">5.4.3 构建镜像</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker build -t grafana:v13.1.2 .
docker images | grep grafana
</code></pre>
<h4 id="544启动容器">5.4.4、启动容器</h4>
<ul>
<li>把容器跑起来</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">docker run -d \
--name grafana \
--restart always \
-p 3000:3000 \
grafana:v13.1.2
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>检测是否启动成功</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-Dockerfile">[root@prometheus grafana]# netstat  -ntulp | grep 3000
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>浏览器访问</li>
</ul>
